notes: Fill values only after a script has measured them on this pipeline (NFR-8). Every number here names the script that produced it. v0.2 dropped the v0.1 SEGMENTATION group (frame-slot detection) and REALIZATION group: neither exists under a direct translation model. Tokenization figures from dhivehi-latin-slm are supporting research, not this system's results.
architecture: v0.2 — one direct Dhivehi Latin <-> English seq2seq model, rule-based transliterator as the Thaana pivot

metrics.name: Round-trip exact Thaana match — news corpus
metrics.value: 27.50% raw, 34.32% folded — exact match punishes the round trip for normalising nonstandard source Thaana; Latin stability is the gated figure (R-1.8)

metrics.name: Largest failing class
metrics.value: spelling_normalised — source Thaana is nonstandard and the round trip corrects it; the Latin is unchanged

metrics.name: Mean subwords per Latin word
metrics.value: 5.697 pieces/word on t5-small (histogram peaks at 5, tail to 15)
